verdict.rationale: The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at omarchy.org/llms.txt). The only agent-oriented documentation is a brief claim that Omarchy ships skills to help your agent build apps, plugins and themes. The manual also notes the omarchy CLI is especially useful when an AI agent helps with configuration, but that is an adjacent CLI capability rather than agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt or llms-full.txt, a documented agent-oriented docs page or markdown export, details of what the shipped skills contain, and independent corroboration.
